name: Support account cancellation policy example
answer:
Customers can cancel subscriptions from the billing page at any time.
Canceled subscriptions remain active until the end of the current billing period.
Canceled subscriptions are automatically refunded for unused time.

sources.title: Support Account Cancellation Policy
sources.content:
Customers can cancel subscriptions from the billing page at any time.
Canceled subscriptions remain active until the end of the current billing period. Refunds are not automatic; customers must request an eligible refund through support.
